issue_context.title: Update expected stats for a few framework regression tests
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
These regression tests should be passing:
- `CompositeAlphaModelFrameworkAlgorithm`
- `StandardDeviationExecutionModelRegressionAlgorithm`
- `VolumeWeightedAveragePriceExecutionModelRegressionAlgorithm`

#### Actual Behavior
The tests above are currently failing.

#### Potential Solution
Update the regression statistics.

#### Reproducing the Problem
Run the regression tests.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)
- [x] I have provided detailed steps to reproduce the issue

review_comments: it looks like these were generated using minute resolutions for the rsi/ema because that was their data resolution. A recent fix to the ema model made this now properly use the resolution parameter which defaults to daily and is now causing no signals to be emitted from the ema model.
